cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Because I need help, not a second direction.
